## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 826 sets during 382 rostered hours. This represents a throughput of 2.2 sets per hour across the review period. The workload was recorded for consideration in the overall grader review and provides the basis for assessing activity alongside the quality findings.

The figures indicate a sustained grading contribution over the period covered. No adjustment to the reported workload figures is noted in the review.

## Quality

A sample of 57 sets was read again. Agreement was 78.9 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with attention to the application of the grading approach in those circumstances.

The quality review considered the reread findings together with the feedback issued. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
